name: Eyelid glue

lead: Eyelid glue is a cosmetic adhesive used to fix the upper lid skin into a fold, producing a temporary double eyelid. The payoff is a visible crease and a larger, more open-looking, defined eye for the day, with no surgery.
It serves the same goal as eyelid tape and is a non-surgical alternative to double eyelid surgery, which creates a permanent crease. No published clinical studies of the glue itself were located.

paras: A thin layer of adhesive holds a fold of lid skin in place so a crease shows when the eye is open. It is applied as part of a daily routine, often with makeup, and lasts until it wears off or is removed.
Any adhesive used next to the eye raises general questions of skin and eye irritation, which have not been specifically studied for these products.

angle.text: Eyelid glue holds the lid skin in a fold to give a visible double eyelid crease and larger, more defined eyes for the day. It is used as a non-surgical alternative to double eyelid surgery. Published research on the product itself is limited.

lead: Eyelid glue is a cosmetic adhesive applied to the upper eyelid to hold the skin in a fold, giving the appearance of a double eyelid for a limited time. It is a non-surgical alternative to double eyelid surgery, which creates a permanent crease [1].
No published clinical studies of eyelid glue were located. This article therefore describes the aesthetic context only and does not assess the product's effects.

paras: A double eyelid is an upper lid with a visible crease. Wikipedia reports natural prevalence of about 41% among Koreans and roughly 70 to 83% among Chinese and Japanese people, and describes double eyelid surgery as among the most common cosmetic procedures in Taiwan and South Korea. The first recorded operation was performed in Japan in 1896 [1]. Surgical options include non-incisional suture methods, which are quicker but may fade, and incisional methods, which are described as longer-lasting [1]. Temporary products such as glue and tape provide a reversible alternative.
